content.short: Chips is a mobile game that attempts to curb crime, violence, and poverty by incentivizing positive decisions.
content.description: Chips is a mobile play-to-earn game built around an open world where players take part in activities, face moral or social-choice challenges, and earn rewards for positive decisions. The project includes two in-game assets: the CHIP coin, which is positioned as a governance token connected to DAO-style ecosystem functions, and the CRUMB token, which serves as the in-game monetary asset. Its positioning combines mobile gameplay, social-impact themes, and tokenized rewards inside a Cardano-connected game economy.
content.meta: Chips is a Cardano-connected mobile game that rewards positive decisions through gameplay and tokenized assets. Explore Chips on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
